description: Ministry of Urban Development and Housing - Declaration and Expansion of Part of Hanguranketha Pradeshiya Sabha Area. Expansion of Urban Development Area Nawalapitiya. Declaration and Expansion of Part of Norwood Pradeshiya Sabha Area and Ambagamuwa Pradeshiya Sabha.
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land matters, specifically declaring an area as an Urban Development Area under the Urban Development Authority Law. It contains detailed descriptions of land boundaries, Grama Niladhari divisions, and metes and bounds for the designated development area in Hanguranketha. While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the core land development purpose, and there are no detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes that would make it a government-related type. The content fits squarely within Land Gazettes as it concerns land use planning and development area declarations.
